answer: The auditor performed limited assurance over Volkswagen's 2025 sustainability statement, with reasonable assurance specifically over EU Taxonomy disclosures and the DCI and base-year-recalculation tables. The engagement followed ISAE 3000 (Revised). Limited-assurance procedures differ in nature and timing and are less extensive, producing substantially lower assurance than reasonable assurance. Where management estimates value-chain information it could not obtain despite reasonable efforts, assurance evaluates ESRS compliance and reasonableness of the estimates but does not independently identify the unavailable value-chain information.

normalized_value.limited_vs_reasonable: less extensive procedures and substantially lower assurance
normalized_value.value_chain_limitation: assesses ESRS-compliant estimation and reasonableness; does not identify unavailable information

evidence.quote: limited assurance engagement on the sustainability statement
reasonable assurance engagement on the disclosures on the EU Taxonomy as well as on DCI and BYR
level of assurance obtained is substantially lower
does not include identifying information in the value chain that the executive directors were unable to obtain
